runnability.evidence: One command regenerates all required artifacts; validate_submission.py enforces UUID, video, report, policy card, trajectory, and stress evaluation.

mujoco_depth.evidence: Five-finger MJCF hand with 22 controllable channels, free joints, hinge/slide joints, actuators, frame sensors, touch sensors, contact geoms, task zones, and generated trajectory.

task_design.evidence: Long-horizon disaster-response medication triage: scan, approach, grasp, uncap, place, confirm, recover, export.

control.evidence: Closed-loop residual policy logs raw and corrected visual-servo error, contact balance, five-finger contact timeline, baseline-prior failure versus residual recovery contrast, slip observer, residual action norm, and policy confidence.

dexterous_manipulation.evidence: Five-finger grasp, thumb opposition, in-hand cap rotation, fragile vial handling, slip recovery, and pod placement.

engineering_quality.evidence: Deterministic implementation, structured artifacts, fixed-seed ablation, validator thresholds, and self-contained submission folder.

presentation.evidence: Demo overlays concise stage text, dynamic route trails, scan beams, residual arrows, slip ripples, raw-vs-corrected servo error, residual norm, confidence, and task metrics; SRT subtitles, contact timeline evidence, and a side-by-side failure-recovery comparison video are included.

innovation.evidence: Safety-confirmed medication triage with residual recovery, baseline-prior contrast, and dataset-export framing.
